ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Csi.exe Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Csi.exe is a signed binary from Microsoft that comes with Visual Studio and provides C# interactive capabilities. It can be used to run C# code from a file passed as a parameter in command line. Early version of this utility provided with Microsoft “Roslyn” Community Technology Preview was named 'rcsi.exe'

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\csi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rcsi\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "csi\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "rcsi\.exe")) AND process_company = "Microsoft\ Corporation")
